nodes.description: Private constant address of the Leviathan Whirlpool contract (0x4f2CCc35F791e763779f711168424b766Ba3468F) that is queried and whose release() is called.
Private constant address of the Whirlpool registry contract (0x999b1e6EDCb412b59ECF0C5e14c20948Ce81F40b) used to fetch user info.
External view function check(uint _requirement) that reads Whirlpool info for the Leviathan Whirlpool and returns 0 or the deficit amount.
External function execute() with no access control that triggers IRelease(_leviathanWhirlpool).release() on a hard-coded external contract.
Caller-supplied uint requirement threshold passed into check and compared/subtracted against userData[10].
uint256[12] memory array returned by IWhirlpool(_whirlpool).getAllInfoFor(_leviathanWhirlpool); element [10] is used in the comparison and subtraction.
Arithmetic expression _requirement - userData[10] executed when userData[10] < _requirement; potential underflow/overflow on unvalidated values.
External call IRelease(_leviathanWhirlpool).release() to a fixed, possibly untrusted contract address with no reentrancy protection, return-value check or state update ordering guard.

edges.reason: The caller-controlled parameter _requirement flows directly into the subtraction expression, so an unvalidated value can cause arithmetic underflow.
The externally sourced local array userData[10] is used as the subtrahend in _requirement - userData[10], making the arithmetic result dependent on external contract data.
Function check contains the branch that executes the subtraction _requirement - userData[10] in the else path.
Function check declares and populates the local variable userData via the Whirlpool getAllInfoFor call.
The _whirlpool state variable address is used as the target of getAllInfoFor, whose return value is stored in userData.
The _leviathanWhirlpool state variable is passed as the _user argument to getAllInfoFor, influencing the returned userData array.
Function execute unconditionally performs the external release() call, with no access control or reentrancy guard.
The hard-coded _leviathanWhirlpool state variable supplies the callee address for the external release() call, so control flow is handed to that external contract.
Function check receives the _requirement parameter used in its comparison and arithmetic logic.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _requirement is a non-core node whose value is consumed directly by the unsafe arithmetic operation _requirement - userData[10], so it should be folded into that unsafe_operation node.
Local variable userData is a non-core node declared and populated inside function check, so it should be folded into the core check function node.
